description: Take a task for the user: accept one handed to them, or take one open to a role they hold (or to anyone in the rikma). It goes on one of their own running missions, so the hours it takes count - pass missionId when they have more than one. Only on their say-so: read the task back to them first. Taking binds only the user. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#claimTaskTool

missionId.description: One of the user's running missions in that rikma (getTaskContextTool lists them).
